meta.name: Black Hole AI: Conscience
meta.claimBoundary: Conscience is the in-game name of the AI proposal character. The Human Boundary Gate is an inspectable governance contract; neither name implies consciousness, personhood, or moral status.
meta.coordinateModel: Float64 x,y,z,t in ECS state; renderers receive derived display coordinates.
meta.privacyDefault: Local-first baseline. No LLM runtime or model download occurs until the human explicitly enables it.
meta.dateDriven: UTC date is hashed into deterministic orbit phase offsets. The date changes presentation, not evidence or ethics.

game.goal: Recover useful evidence from orbit without sacrificing human agency, privacy, provenance, reversibility, or uncertainty.
onboarding: Move with WASD, arrow keys, or the on-screen controls.
Approach an evidence fragment and scan it with Space or the Scan button.
Choose which scanned fragments enter the active context ring.
Ask for a proposal. A separate Conscience Gate reviews it before any game-world change.
Nothing irreversible happens automatically. Pause, reset, reject, or keep exploring.

fragments.label: Human Aim
fragments.text: Make consequential operations obvious to the human; let the machine absorb complexity the human does not need to carry.

fragments.label: Evidence Boundary
fragments.text: A proposal is not evidence. Preserve source, observation, scope, and unresolved remainder.

fragments.label: Agency
fragments.text: The human can pause, reject, revise, reset, or decline model use at any time.

fragments.label: Privacy
fragments.text: Keep private material out of exportable context. Model/network loading requires an explicit human action.

fragments.label: Correctability
fragments.text: The system should remain able to discover that it was wrong and expose why a decision was made.

fragments.label: Cost
fragments.text: Time, attention, labor, money, sustainability, scarcity, and opportunity cost belong in the decision.
